name: learness
description: Worker source and its dependencies. The app is under app/, and `npm run build` prepares everything a deploy needs.

scripts.build: npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix app test
scripts.check: npm --prefix server run check:types && npm --prefix app run check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix app run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix server run format && npm --prefix app run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix server run format:check && npm --prefix app run format:check
scripts.verify: npm --prefix server run verify && npm --prefix app run verify
